results.question: Can I return a discounted product after 7 days?
results.answer: Returns Policy: Returns are allowed within 7 days of delivery for unused products with original packaging. Discounted products are returnable only if the discount is 30 percent or less.

results.question: Can I exchange a product for a different size?
results.answer: Exchange Policy: Size exchanges are allowed within 10 days of delivery, subject to stock availability. Exchange is not available for intimate wear or final sale products.

results.question: How long does standard delivery take?
results.answer: Shipping Policy: Standard delivery usually takes 3 to 5 business days. Express delivery usually takes 1 to 2 business days in serviceable pin codes. Orders above Rs. 1,999 qualify for free standard shipping.

results.question: When will I get my refund for a return?
results.answer: Refund Policy: Refunds are processed after the returned item passes quality inspection. Prepaid refunds are generally issued within 5 to 7 business days. Cash-on-delivery orders are refunded to customer bank/UPI details after verification.

results.question: Is physical damage covered under warranty?
results.answer: Warranty Policy: Watches and selected accessories carry a 6-month limited warranty against manufacturing defects. Physical damage and normal wear are excluded.
